vibe_rationale: Community-run queer club and performance festival with a themed yearly identity and fiercely local roots, but a narrow single-community focus.
fit_notes: Adult LGBTIQ+ community with deep regional roots; any presence would need to serve the community first, through the members' organisation, with a recovery or wellbeing space. The attendance figure dates from 2015 and no commercial sponsors were found, so reach is uncertain; it is an NSW event.
